name: Wordmark
job: Sign a surface as ARCS Field OS in one line of mono type that scales with whatever size its context sets.

anatomy.role: 0.45em, baseline aligned; the size comes from the parent

states.name: Signature
states.note: Label size, beside a name and email (the storyboard closing frame).

states.name: Title card
states.note: Alone on a frame over the horizon line (the storyboard opening).

use_when: A page or a video frame needs the ARCS Field OS signature.
The surface inlines or links the kit tokens.
avoid_when: The surface names a product line instead (ARCS · 12D ORBITAL style headers); those are a different lockup.
A counterpart page where the ARCS brand would distract from the ask; the Brooks one-pager signs with a name only.

data.note: The words are fixed; set `font-size` on the parent or a context rule.

access: `aria-label="ARCS Field OS"` on the element so it reads as one name, not two words spelled by letter.
Colour is decoration only; the words carry the name.

used_by.name: Brooks pitch storyboard: opening and closing frames

gates: `scripts/kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
`scripts/page_gate.py`, `scripts/token_source_gate.py`, and the Impeccable detector at 0 findings.
